title: Account migration started (v1)
description:
Event generated when an account migration is started. Contains the payload with the data to be migrated.

**Note:** This is an outdated version of the event. In most cases, you should use Account migration started (v2) instead.

acquisition_channel.description: The id of the acquisition channel the form comes from.

external_id.description: A record identifier for external purposes

printed_name.description: The applicant's name to be printed on the card (max. 25 characters)

social_name.description: The applicant social name used for descriptions and printed name

marital_status.description: The applicant's marital status. Valid values (SINGLE, MARRIED, DIVORCED, WIDOWER).

other_id_number.description: Another document number. For example, RG in Brazil

address_type.description: The address's type. Valid values (RESIDENTIAL, COMMERCIAL, OTHER)

mailing_address.description: Flag indicating if this address should be marked as a mailing address

date.description: The date since the address belongs to the applicant, formatted as yyyy-MM-dd

phone_type.description: The phone's type. Valid values (RESIDENTIAL, COMMERCIAL, MOBILE).

external_id.description: This will be your ID used to identify the account at the Pismo platform

registration_number.description: The number under which the company is registered

annual_revenues.description: The average monthly revenue for the last 12 months

external_id.description: A record identifier for external purposes.

limit.description: A user-defined account limit, between 0 and the granted limit

granted_limit.description: The amount granted to the applicant's account.

available_credit_limit.description: The amount available to the applicant's account

exchange_mode.description: Wether any foreign transaction should be charged by the exchange rate at the day it occurred or at the statement's closing date. Valid values (SAME_DAY, CLOSING)

is_overlimit.description: Whether the account has hit the granted limit during the current cycle at least once

total_installment_credit_limit.description: Total amount granted for a separate account credit limit, e.g. a program-specific credit line.

available_total_installment_credit.description: Available amount for the separate credit limit defined by `total_installment_credit_limit`

id.description: A record identifier for migration purposes.

version_date.description: A record identifier for update data. Valid format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.sssZ).

creation_date.description: A record identifier for update data. Valid formats YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ

create_statements.description: Flag that indicates the statements creation.

open_due_date.description: Date filled with expiration date on the day of the customer' cycle closing. When the customer pays more than the minimum on the invoice, the date is removed, otherwise it is kept to demonstrate the base day of the customer's due date.

due_date.description: The id of the account due date chosen from the possible values allowed for this program.

program_id.description: ID of the program the account is associated with.
